title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Open People. Choose People in the menu on the left, then the Service users tab.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Choose Add a person. The form has five parts: Who they are, Where they live, Getting in, Their GP and Who pays.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Fill in who they are. Full name is required. Add their preferred name, date of birth and NHS number if you have them.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Add where they live. Enter the address and postcode. HomecareOS places their home on a map so travel between visits can be worked out.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Add how to get in. Write the access instructions and the key safe code. Carers see the code only when they tap to reveal it.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Save with Add this person. The person's record opens on Details.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Work through Getting started. The strip at the top shows what is ready and what is not: care plan published, consent for care, allergies, hours or private pay, door-critical fields and the next care plan review. Each check opens the place to fix it.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Your role must allow you to add people. If it does not, HomecareOS tells you who can.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: Have the address and how to get in to hand. The key safe code is only shown to carers behind a tap.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: The person's record has six areas down the left: Details, Care plan, Clinical, Safety, People and Admin.

title: Add a new service user
summary: Add a person, place their home on the map, and see what is still needed before care starts.
step_text: If someone leaves your service, their record and its history are kept.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Open the person's care plan. Go to People, open the person, then choose Care plan on the left. The plan's groups run across the top, with Overview first.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Start with About me. Write who they are, what matters to them and how they like to be supported, in their own words where you can.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Fill in each section. Each section has its own page. Many questions take a one-tap answer, with More detail when you need to write more. Sections you have changed are saved as drafts until you publish.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_title: Add tasks and choose their visits
step_text: Add tasks and choose their visits. Open Tasks. For each task, choose which visits it belongs to and on which days. Future visits are brought into line from the date you choose.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Add observations and outcomes. Ask carers to record a reading, such as fluids or blood pressure, as a task on the visit. Add the outcomes the person wants, so progress can be written against them.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Score the risks. Score each risk, add the controls in place and set a date to check back.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_title: Write what to do if a visit is late or missed
step_text: Write what to do if a visit is late or missed. Under the carer view, record the person's contingency plan, so the office and carers know the plan B.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Review and publish. Open Check & publish, record the review and choose Publish. Publishing records the review, the dates and the draft sections together.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Add the person first. See Add a new service user.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Use Preview as carer to see the plan the way a carer will.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: The Overview shows the review dates your nation's regulator expects.

title: Build a care plan
summary: Write the plan in the person's words, put tasks on the right visits, then review and publish.
step_text: Starting a person's very first plan in the new screens is still being built. If the person has no plan yet, call us on 01905 674704 and we will get it started with you.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Open Rota & visits. Choose Rota & visits in the menu. The tabs across the top are Rota, Visits, Plan and Runs & areas.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Choose Schedule a visit. On the Visits tab, choose Schedule a visit.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Fill in who and when. Choose who the visit is for, the date, the start time (UK time), the length and the kind of visit.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Book the carers. Add the carer, or carers for a double-up. Leave nobody chosen to put the visit on Needs cover.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Add notes and place. Write any notes for the carers. If the visit is not at their home, tick The visit is not at their home and enter the address.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Save. HomecareOS confirms the visit is scheduled, or tells you if there is something to check. The carers are told, and the new visit's card opens.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Check the rota. Open the Rota tab to see the day or week, with each carer's planned and actual times and their travel.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Add the person first. See Add a new service user.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: The Visits list and the Rota show whether a visit has reached the carer's phone.

title: Set up the rota: schedule a visit
summary: Schedule a visit, book a carer, and see it on the day and week rota.
step_text: Carers are sent changes to their next 36 hours, even with the app closed.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Choose the day. The day you are looking at. Choose Yesterday, Today or Tomorrow, use the arrows to step a day (a week in Week view), or the calendar for any date.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Choose the view. Day shows one day by the hour. Week shows seven days. Map shows where the visits are. Template shows the repeating weekly pattern, which is a plan with no status.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Narrow it down. Search finds a carer or a run. Area, Run and Time narrow the rota. The counts (All visits, Unallocated, Missed, Sick, On leave) filter to those when chosen.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Read a carer's row. The carer's name and hours booked this week against their contract (31/37h), with a bar. Underneath: today's care, time on the road and waiting. S is off sick, L on leave, A another absence, OT over contract, and the car means they drive.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Read a visit. One planned visit: its time and the person. The frame is the plan; the solid bar above it is when the carer actually clocked in and out, so a short or late visit shows at a glance. The colour says where the visit is up to. See the colour key below.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Read the marks. +35 is minutes late, 72% is a short visit, ×2 is a double-up (1 of 2 means it still needs a second carer). A dashed amber edge means the visit overlaps another of this carer's visits.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Read the travel. Under each carer's visits: the drive between them in minutes, then a dotted line for waiting. Red hatching means the drive runs into the next visit's start.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Check Unallocated. Visits nobody is booked on yet. They need cover: drag one onto a carer, or right-click it and choose Find cover.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Check hours per hour. Care booked in each hour against the carers who can work it, with how many hours spare or short underneath. Navy is covered, dark orange has no carer yet.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Open a visit. Hover a visit for its times and counts of tasks, medication, observations and notes. Click it to open the full visit card beside the rota: what was planned, what is happening and what happened, with Correct times, Cancel visit and Reassign. Legend opens the key to every colour and mark on the rota.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Open Rota & visits in the menu, then the Rota tab.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Still to come: booked with a carer and not started yet.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: On a visit: a carer has clocked in and is there now.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Delivered: the carer has clocked out. The visit is done.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Late: the start time has passed and nobody has clocked in yet.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Missed: nobody clocked in within 45 minutes of the start (your agency can change this), or it was marked missed.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: No carer: nobody is booked on it. It sits on the Unallocated row.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Cancelled: cancelled with a reason. It stays on the rota, struck through, for the record.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Sick, Annual leave, Other absence: a band across the carer's row. Marking someone sick today moves their visits to Unallocated for cover.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: To reassign or move, drag a visit to another carer's row, or along the row to a new time. HomecareOS checks for clashes first, and Ctrl+Z undoes it.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Right-click a visit for Edit, Find cover, Reassign, Unassign, Mark as cancelled (with a reason and any charge) or Delete. Right-click a carer to mark them sick today, add an event or open their profile. On a tablet, tap a visit for Open visit, Edit, Reassign or Cancel.

title: Read the rota: colours, marks, Unallocated and travel
summary: What each row, colour, mark and line on the rota means, and where to click next.
step_text: Event books a carer for training, supervision, a meeting and the like. New visit adds a one-off visit. ⋯ holds Copy week and Apply run, which create visits in bulk.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Open the visit. On the Rota, click a visit. On the Visits tab, choose a visit in the list. On a laptop the card opens beside the page; on a phone it fills the screen. Choose Open as a page to give it the whole page.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Read the three parts. Planned: when, the carers booked, travelling in, tasks, medicines due, service and place, and notes for the carers. Happening now shows only while a carer is there. What happened: clock in and out, with planned, actual, paid and charged times, then tasks, medicines, care notes, observations, body map, incidents and family sign-off.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_title: Check it has reached the carer's phone
step_text: Check it has reached the carer's phone. Before the visit, each booked carer shows On their phone with when it was confirmed, or Not on their phone yet with when their phone last checked in.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Correct clock times. Choose Correct times. Change each carer's clocked in and clocked out date and time, and give a reason. Tick Mark the visit complete once every carer is clocked out if it should be. The reason is kept on the audit trail.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Change the date or time. Schedule changes the date, start and finish. Move does the same and always asks for a reason, which is kept with the move. If the new time is usually a different call, HomecareOS asks which call it should be.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Change the carer. Choose Reassign, then Add a carer or Replace a booked carer who has not clocked in. Who is free for this visit lists free carers first, ranked, with their drive, how often they have visited the person and their hours this week. Choose Send beside the carer you want.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Take a carer off. Take off removes a carer who has not clocked in. If nobody is left on the visit, it needs cover.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Cancel the visit. Choose Cancel visit, then the reason and the charge. See Cancel a visit.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Put the record right. Choose Corrections to correct A task, record A missed dose given but not recorded, Add a note written up by the office, or Correct a note. Each asks why, and the reason is kept.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Read the change history. Open Change history at the bottom to see who changed what, and when. What this history may not show lists the changes not recorded there yet, such as carers dragged on the rota.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Changing a visit needs a role that can edit visits. Other roles see the card read only.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Details changes the service it is billed as, the kind of visit, the call, whether it needs a driver, and the address if the visit is not at their home.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: After a save, HomecareOS offers Undo where the change can be undone.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Delete in error is only for a visit that was never care. It is not offered once someone has clocked in, once the visit is completed or missed, or once it is on an invoice. Cancel instead.

title: Use the visit card: times, carers, cancelling and history
summary: See planned against delivered, correct times, change carers, cancel, and read the change history.
step_text: Photos stay on the current visit page, linked from the card.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Set the person's visits. Go to People, open the person, choose Care plan, then Visits. Switch each visit on, such as Morning, Lunch, Tea or Bed, then set its days (Every day, Weekdays or Weekends), start, length and one or two carers.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Add any different days. Use Different on some days for a visit that is shorter or later on some days, with the reason carers see.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Save from a date. Choose the Starting from date, then Save changes. Everything before that date stays as it was, and nothing is deleted.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Open the Plan. Choose Rota & visits, then Plan. Pick a view: By client, By carer, By run, Week timeline or List. On a two-week rota, choose Both weeks, Week 1 or Week 2.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Check what needs fixing. Four figures sit at the top: calls that need a carer, calls entered twice, carers in two places at once, and people with a medicine or task no call delivers. Choose one to see those calls.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Open a call. Choose a call to open its panel: length, call window, kind, service, run, carers and anything flagged.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Choose who goes. In the call's panel, choose Change who goes. Pick a carer on each line and their part: Lead, Support (second carer), Shadowing or Supervisor. Carers are ranked as the rota's cover finder ranks them. Save. Empty seats on the visits already on the rota are filled too.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_title: Change the day, time or length
step_text: Change the day, time or length. Use the link in the call's panel. It opens the person's care plan, where the visit is changed.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Add the person first. See Add a new service user.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Can carers be suggested? shows how ready the plan is for HomecareOS to suggest carers. Roles that can change the rota can have carers proposed for calls with nobody named, then tick the ones to apply. Nothing changes until someone applies them.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Suggest better carers for filled calls looks for long hours, a more familiar carer or less driving. Each suggestion is accepted or dismissed one at a time.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: A carer is in two places at once when two of their calls overlap. It allows no travel time, so back to back calls in different homes are not flagged.

title: Plan repeating visits
summary: Set each person's regular visits, choose who usually goes, and fix what the Plan flags.
step_text: Finance roles see each call's charge, cost and margin.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Open Runs & areas. Choose Rota & visits, then Runs & areas. The views are Runs, Pairs and Areas.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Add an area. On Areas, choose New area. Give it a name, a colour and its postcode districts, the first part of a postcode such as WR5 or B12. Choose Add the area.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Put people in areas. In no area lists carers and people receiving care who are in no area yet. Choose people and put them in an area. Open an area and choose Who is in it to add people who live in its postcodes, or take people out.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Add a run. On Runs, choose New run. Give it a name, an optional description and an area. Choose Add the run.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Add the stops. Open the run and choose Stops. For each stop, choose the person, when it starts in minutes after the first stop, its length, the kind of visit and the service. Choose Save the stops.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_title: Put recurring calls on the run
step_text: Put recurring calls on the run. Choose Recurring calls. Tick calls and choose Put on this run, or Take off the run. A run with no recurring calls is not on the weekly plan.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_title: Lay out a run on a day
step_text: Lay out a run on a day. On the Rota, open the ⋯ menu and choose Apply run.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Pair two carers. On Pairs, choose New pair, pick the first and second carer, then Pair them. Pause or resume a pair at any time. The table shows who drives in each pair.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Making changes needs a role that can edit the rota. Other roles see these pages read only.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Retiring an area leaves the people in it in no area. Who they were is kept on the audit trail.

title: Set up runs, pairs and areas
summary: Group calls into rounds, pair carers, and split your patch into postcode areas.
step_text: Deleting a run and suggesting runs are still on the current runs page.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_title: Take the carer off their visits
step_text: Take the carer off their visits. On the Rota, right-click the carer and mark them sick today: their visits move to Unallocated. Or open a visit and use Take off or Reassign on the visit card. A visit with nobody left on it needs cover.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Open Today, then Needs cover. The top line says how many visits have no carer in the next 48 hours and the next 14 days. It refreshes every minute while the page is open.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Read the next 14 days. Each day shows its visits with no carer, and double-ups short of a second carer, by call. Choose a day to go to its visits.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: See why they need cover. Why they need cover groups them: No carer booked or Second carer needed. Cover one carer's run of calls in one go: each line opens the first day it starts.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_title: Choose Find cover on a visit
step_text: Choose Find cover on a visit. Each visit shows the person, its time, length, service and call, and who is already booked. Find cover opens the carers for that visit.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Pick a carer. Free carers come first, ranked, each with a match score, their drive, how often they have visited the person and their hours free this week. To weigh lists anything to think about first. Carers who are not free are listed under Not free at this time, with why.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Send them. Choose Send beside the carer. HomecareOS books them on the visit, as the second carer on a double-up, and says so. Choose Refresh the list.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Work down the list. When every visit has a carer, Needs cover says Every visit in the next 14 days has a carer.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Finding and booking cover needs a role that can change the rota. Other roles see Needs cover read only.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Approved leave frees that carer's visits for cover in the same way. See Approve or decline a leave request.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: On the rota, you can also drag a visit from the Unallocated row onto a carer, or right-click it and choose Find cover.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: Once a carer is booked, the visit card shows when the visit has reached their phone.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: If some days say visits are not created for everyone yet, those days may still need cover once the visits are made from the Plan.

title: Find cover: visits that need a carer
summary: See every visit with no carer in the next 14 days, then use Find cover to book someone who is free.
step_text: An I'm unwell button in the carer app, which tells the office and lists the rest of the carer's day for cover.

title: Cancel a visit
summary: Cancel with a reason and a charge, and keep the visit on the record.
step_text: Open the visit. From Rota & visits > Visits, open the visit. The visit card shows its buttons along the top: Schedule, Correct times, Cancel visit, Move and Reassign.

title: Cancel a visit
summary: Cancel with a reason and a charge, and keep the visit on the record.
step_text: Choose Cancel visit. Choose the reason: Client cancelled, Carer unavailable, No cover available or Other. It is kept on the audit trail.

title: Cancel a visit
summary: Cancel with a reason and a charge, and keep the visit on the record.
step_text: Choose the charge. Choose No charge, Half charge, Full charge or A set amount in pounds. HomecareOS suggests a full charge under 12 hours before the visit, half from 12 to 24 hours, and none before that.

title: Cancel a visit
summary: Cancel with a reason and a charge, and keep the visit on the record.
step_text: Choose Cancel this visit. The visit is cancelled and stays on the record with its reason and charge. HomecareOS offers Undo straight after where it can.

title: Cancel a visit
summary: Cancel with a reason and a charge, and keep the visit on the record.
step_text: If you got the reason or charge wrong, open the cancelled visit again and choose Change reason and charge. You can change the reason and the charge only.

title: Cancel a visit
summary: Cancel with a reason and a charge, and keep the visit on the record.
step_text: Delete in error is only for a visit that should never have been booked. Once someone has clocked in, cancel instead.

title: Approve or decline a leave request
summary: Decide a carer's holiday or leave request, and see who else is off.
step_text: Open Today, then Leave requests. Requests waiting for a decision are listed under Waiting.

title: Approve or decline a leave request
summary: Decide a carer's holiday or leave request, and see who else is off.
step_text: Check the dates. Each request shows who else has asked for the same dates, so you can see whether you can cover it.

title: Approve or decline a leave request
summary: Decide a carer's holiday or leave request, and see who else is off.
step_text: Approve or decline. Choose Approve, or Decline. HomecareOS asks you for a reason before you decline.

title: Approve or decline a leave request
summary: Decide a carer's holiday or leave request, and see who else is off.
step_text: Cover their visits. Once leave is approved, that carer's visits in those dates need cover. See Cover a sick carer.

title: Approve or decline a leave request
summary: Decide a carer's holiday or leave request, and see who else is off.
step_text: Requests decided in the last 90 days are listed under Recently decided.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Open the person's record. Go to People and open the person.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Choose Clinical, then Chart. The tabs are Medicines, Chart, Body map and Observations. The chart's top line says the most important things this week.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Read This week. The summary lists, where there are any: doses not recorded, doses refused or not given, doses recorded twice, doses shown twice in the carer app, doses not on any visit, and records that match no round. Each opens the chart.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Choose the week. Use Earlier week, This week and Later week. On a phone the chart shows one day at a time.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Read each medicine. Each medicine shows its rounds, by the call and time it is due, then each day of the week. Green is given or self administered. Amber is refused, withheld, not available or another reason it was not given. Red is not recorded: every call that offers it has finished and nothing is recorded.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Open a record. A record shows the round, the dose, the call, who recorded it and when, any witness, and the reason or notes. For an as-needed (PRN) dose it shows why it was needed.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_title: Check where the carer app goes wrong
step_text: Check where the carer app goes wrong. Not on any visit (No call offers it) means no call that day offers the dose, so the carer app does not show it. Shown twice means a long, live-in or night call offers the same dose at two calls. Shown at every call means the medicine has no time set.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Change medicines. Choose Change medicines. Add a medicine with its name, dose, kind (regular at set calls, as needed, or once only), when it repeats, prescriber and start date, and mark it controlled or high risk. Change a medicine, or Discontinue it with a reason. Imported medicines wait until you Start it.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Record a dose or print. Record a dose and printing the MAR open the full medicines page.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: The chart needs a role that can see medicines. Changing medicines needs a role that can edit them.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: Nothing is deleted. A discontinued medicine stays on the record with its reason, and MAR records are never changed.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: A dose given but not recorded, for example because the phone was offline, can be recorded afterwards on the visit card: Corrections > A missed dose, with the time it was given and why.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: A dose given after midnight on a night call counts on the next day, and its record says so.

title: Check medicines on the MAR chart
summary: See every dose for the week, what was recorded, where the carer app would miss a dose, and change the medicines list.
step_text: A dose given against a safety rule is kept, flagged and the office is alerted.

title: Invite a carer to the app
summary: Add the carer with their email address, then send their invite to the carer app.
step_text: Open People, then Carers. Choose People in the menu, then the Carers tab.

title: Invite a carer to the app
summary: Add the carer with their email address, then send their invite to the carer app.
step_text: Add the carer. Choose Add a carer and fill in their details, including their email address. Save.

title: Invite a carer to the app
summary: Add the carer with their email address, then send their invite to the carer app.
step_text: Send the invite. On People > Carers, choose Invite beside the carer. HomecareOS asks you to confirm, then Send it sends the invite to the email on their record. The Invite button shows only for a current carer with no app login yet.

title: Invite a carer to the app
summary: Add the carer with their email address, then send their invite to the carer app.
step_text: The carer activates their account. The carer opens the email, taps the link and chooses a password of at least 8 characters.

title: Invite a carer to the app
summary: Add the carer with their email address, then send their invite to the carer app.
step_title: The carer downloads the app and signs in
step_text: The carer downloads the app and signs in. Send them Carer: download the app and sign in.

title: Invite a carer to the app
summary: Add the carer with their email address, then send their invite to the carer app.
step_text: You need the carer's email address. Without it they cannot be invited and will not see their visits.

title: Invite a carer to the app
summary: Add the carer with their email address, then send their invite to the carer app.
step_text: If the carer did not get the email, check the address on their record and use Resend invite.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Open Money, then Timesheets. Choose the week with Earlier week, This week and Later week.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Clear Needs attention. Four lists come first: Still clocked in (clock ins still open after 12 hours), Clocked, not in the timesheet, Off plan (more than 10 minutes over or under) and Held from pay. Nothing held is paid until someone looks.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Read the ledger. Each carer's calls by day: clocked from the clock times, planned from the rota, and the stored timesheet where it differs. A carer marked Timesheet differs needs a look. Choose a carer to see their week, with what is ready to pay.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Put it right. Correct a clock time on the visit card with Correct times. Confirming, adjusting or retracting a timesheet entry is on the current timesheets page: choose Open live timesheets.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Open Time checks. Money > Time checks compares planned against delivered for a period: visits on plan, over plan, under plan, and those that cannot be checked. Choose a visit for its clock times, charged time and care notes.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Open Payroll. Money > Payroll shows each pay calendar, and the carers on it: who is ready, who is held and why. Mileage lists claims waiting for approval. Pay rates & minimum wage shows each carer's rate against the minimum, anyone below it first.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Run pay. Pay runs are generated, approved and paid on the current payroll page. Each run on the Payroll tab opens there.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Timesheets and Payroll need a role that can see payroll. Time checks needs a role that can see finance.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Travel is paid through mileage, never in timesheet pay totals.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Pending and disputed mileage claims are held back from the pay run until someone decides.

title: From timesheets to time checks to payroll
summary: Check the week's timesheets, look at visits off plan, then run pay with nothing held.
step_text: Adjusting a visit's charged time and printing the case for a council are on the current time checks pages, linked from Time checks.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Open Money, then Invoices. The picture at the top shows invoices by state: Draft, Sent, Part paid, Overdue and Paid. Choose a state to list only those.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: See what payers owe. What payers owe shows the total owed, how much is past due, the drafts, and who owes most.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Narrow the list. Choose a Payer and Show invoices. The list is newest first, with the number, who it is billed to, the period, the amount, when it is due and its state.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Check an invoice. Choose an invoice to see its facts, each line with its visit, person and service, what was billed and the price, and the totals.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Generate an invoice. Choose Create invoice at the top of the page. It opens the current invoicing page: choose Generate Invoice. Choose the payer, the period start and end, and how the lines are laid out: one line per visit, grouped by service user, or grouped by service type. Add a purchase order if the payer needs one.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Send it. On the chosen invoice, choose Send, then Send Invoice. It is emailed to the payer with the PDF attached. Once sent, you can Resend it. Download PDF is there too.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Record payment. When money arrives, choose Mark paid on the invoice, then Record Payment and enter the payment date and the amount received. A payment for less than the total leaves the invoice part paid.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Set up who pays you and their services and rates first, under Money > Rates & rules.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: You need a role that can see finance.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Refresh prices prices the visits again as a new invoice would today: the current service, rate card and rounding settings, and the visits as recorded now.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: Void invoice is only for an invoice created in error that has not been sent. It deletes the invoice and releases its visits so they can be corrected and invoiced again.

title: Check, send and chase invoices
summary: See what payers owe, check each invoice's lines, then generate, send and record payment.
step_text: A visit's charged time is shown on its visit card under What happened, beside the planned, actual and paid times.

title: Carer: download the app and sign in
summary: Get the app, activate your account from your invite, and sign in.
step_text: Activate your account. Open the invite email and tap the link. Choose a password of at least 8 characters and type it again to confirm.

title: Carer: download the app and sign in
summary: Get the app, activate your account from your invite, and sign in.
step_text: Download the app. Get the HomecareOS Carer app from the App Store or Google Play.

title: Carer: download the app and sign in
summary: Get the app, activate your account from your invite, and sign in.
step_text: Sign in. Open the app, enter your email address and password, and tap Sign In.

title: Carer: download the app and sign in
summary: Get the app, activate your account from your invite, and sign in.
step_text: See your visits. Your visits are listed in order. Tap a visit to see the address, how to get in, and the tasks.

title: Carer: download the app and sign in
summary: Get the app, activate your account from your invite, and sign in.
step_text: Check your email for the invite from your agency. If it has not arrived, ask the office to check your email address.

title: Carer: download the app and sign in
summary: Get the app, activate your account from your invite, and sign in.
step_text: Forgotten your password? Type your email address on the sign-in screen, then tap Forgot password?. See Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: Check the day. Choose Today, Tomorrow or Future visits at the top of your visits list.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: Pull down to refresh. Pull the list down and let go. The app fetches your visits again.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: Check your signal. With no signal, the list says No signal: showing what's saved on this phone with when it was last updated. Future visits are not saved on your phone, so you need signal to see them.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_title: Check for a message from the office
step_text: Check for a message from the office. If the office has taken a visit off your round, the app tells you at the top of the list.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_title: Check you signed in with the right email
step_text: Check you signed in with the right email. Sign in with the email address your agency invited. If you have more than one email address, ask the office which one is on your record.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: Forgotten your password? On the sign-in screen, type your email address, then tap Forgot password? Open the email on this phone and tap the link to set a new password.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: Still missing? Ask the office. The office can check that you are booked on the visit, and whether it has reached your phone.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: Never activated your account? Open the invite email from your agency and tap the link first. If it has not arrived, ask the office to check your email address and send it again.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: For the office: the Visits list shows On phone or Not on phone yet for each booked carer before the visit. A carer with an Invite button beside them on People > Carers has no app login yet.

title: Carer: my visits are not showing, or I cannot sign in
summary: Check the right day, refresh, check your signal, and reset a forgotten password.
step_text: For the office: a visit with nobody booked is on Needs cover, not on any carer's phone. See Cover a sick carer.

title: Carer: clock in and out
summary: Clock in by GPS, QR code or NFC tag, and clock out when the visit is done.
step_text: Open the visit. Tap the visit in your list when you arrive.

title: Carer: clock in and out
summary: Clock in by GPS, QR code or NFC tag, and clock out when the visit is done.
step_text: Tap Clock in. If the home uses a QR code or NFC tag, the app asks you to scan it. Otherwise it finds your location.

title: Carer: clock in and out
summary: Clock in by GPS, QR code or NFC tag, and clock out when the visit is done.
step_text: Confirm. With location, wait while the app finds where you are, then confirm. If your location cannot be found, the app may offer to clock in without it. The office can see that it was clocked in without a location.

title: Carer: clock in and out
summary: Clock in by GPS, QR code or NFC tag, and clock out when the visit is done.
step_text: Do the visit. Work through the tasks, notes and medicines.

title: Carer: clock in and out
summary: Clock in by GPS, QR code or NFC tag, and clock out when the visit is done.
step_text: Tap Clock out. If any tasks are not done, the app lists them under Before you go. Finish them, or say why you are finishing without them.

title: Carer: clock in and out
summary: Clock in by GPS, QR code or NFC tag, and clock out when the visit is done.
step_text: Confirm the clock out. The visit shows as complete.

title: Carer: clock in and out
summary: Clock in by GPS, QR code or NFC tag, and clock out when the visit is done.
step_text: No signal? The app keeps your clock in and out and sends them when signal returns.

title: Carer: complete tasks and notes
summary: Complete or skip each task with a reason, record readings, and write your care notes.
step_text: Open Tasks on the visit. Tap Tasks, or View all tasks.

title: Carer: complete tasks and notes
summary: Complete or skip each task with a reason, record readings, and write your care notes.
step_text: Complete each task. Tap Complete when it is done.

title: Carer: complete tasks and notes
summary: Complete or skip each task with a reason, record readings, and write your care notes.
step_text: Skip with a reason. If a task was not done, tap Skip and choose a reason, such as Client refused, Client asleep, Client not home or Not needed today, or write your own.

title: Carer: complete tasks and notes
summary: Complete or skip each task with a reason, record readings, and write your care notes.
step_text: Record observations. If a task asks for a reading, tap Record observation and enter it.

title: Carer: complete tasks and notes
summary: Complete or skip each task with a reason, record readings, and write your care notes.
step_text: Write your care note. Tap Add Note, choose the note type (General, Observation or Alert), write the note and tap Save Note.

title: Carer: complete tasks and notes
summary: Complete or skip each task with a reason, record readings, and write your care notes.
step_text: Use an Alert note for something the office needs to know about. For anything worrying, raise a concern instead. See Carer: report an incident or raise a concern.

title: Carer: complete tasks and notes
summary: Complete or skip each task with a reason, record readings, and write your care notes.
step_text: No signal? Tasks and notes are kept on your phone and sent when signal returns.

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_text: Open Medications on the visit. Tap Medications. Medicines due this visit are listed first, then As needed (PRN).

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_text: Read any warning. If HomecareOS shows a warning before you give a dose, read it before you go on. Allergies, controlled and high-risk medicines are marked.

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_text: Choose the outcome. Record what happened, for example Given, Refused, Withheld or Missed. Add a note if it helps.

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_title: For a PRN medicine, give the reason
step_text: For a PRN medicine, give the reason. Say why you gave it.

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_title: For a patch, mark the site
step_text: For a patch, mark the site. Tap the body map to record where the patch was placed.

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_text: Submit. The dose is recorded against the visit with your name and the time.

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_text: If a second carer needs to witness a dose, the app asks for them.

title: Carer: record medicines (eMAR)
summary: Record each dose due at this visit, with the outcome, PRN reason or patch site.
step_text: No signal? Doses are kept on your phone and sent when signal returns.

title: Carer: report an incident or raise a concern
summary: Tell the office about an incident or a worry from the visit, there and then.
step_title: Open the visit and tap Report Incident
step_text: Open the visit and tap Report Incident. Choose Report an incident for something that happened, or Raise a concern for something you noticed.

title: Carer: report an incident or raise a concern
summary: Tell the office about an incident or a worry from the visit, there and then.
step_text: For an incident. Choose what kind it was, such as a fall, a medication error or a safeguarding concern. Say how serious it is, when it happened, and what happened in your words.

title: Carer: report an incident or raise a concern
summary: Tell the office about an incident or a worry from the visit, there and then.
step_text: For a concern. Say what you noticed and what is worrying you about it, and how soon the office should look at it.

title: Carer: report an incident or raise a concern
summary: Tell the office about an incident or a worry from the visit, there and then.
step_text: Say what you did. Optional, but it helps the office. Tick I have already phoned the office about this if you have.

title: Carer: report an incident or raise a concern
summary: Tell the office about an incident or a worry from the visit, there and then.
step_text: Send it. Tap Send report or Send to the office. It goes straight to the office.

title: Carer: report an incident or raise a concern
summary: Tell the office about an incident or a worry from the visit, there and then.
step_text: If you think someone is at risk of abuse or neglect, follow your agency's safeguarding policy as well as reporting it here.

title: Carer: request holiday or leave
summary: Ask for annual leave or other time off from your phone.
step_text: Open Leave in the app. Go to Leave and tap + New Request.

title: Carer: request holiday or leave
summary: Ask for annual leave or other time off from your phone.
step_text: Choose the leave type. For example Annual Leave, Medical Appt, Training Day, Compassionate or Unpaid Leave.

title: Carer: request holiday or leave
summary: Ask for annual leave or other time off from your phone.
step_text: Choose the dates. Tap to set the start date, then the end date.

title: Carer: request holiday or leave
summary: Ask for annual leave or other time off from your phone.
step_title: Add a note if you need to
step_text: Add a note if you need to. Notes are optional.

title: Carer: request holiday or leave
summary: Ask for annual leave or other time off from your phone.
step_text: Tap Submit Request. The request is sent to the office. You can cancel it from the same screen.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS
summary: Work through Getting started, then people, care plans, visits, carers and your team.
step_text: Open Today. The Getting started card shows how many of the seven steps are done. Each step opens the place to do it.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS
summary: Work through Getting started, then people, care plans, visits, carers and your team.
step_text: Complete your agency profile. Your address and phone number, for invoices and letters.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS
summary: Work through Getting started, then people, care plans, visits, carers and your team.
step_title: Add who pays you, and your services and rates
step_text: Add who pays you, and your services and rates. A council, a family or the person themselves, and what you charge for each kind of visit.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS
summary: Work through Getting started, then people, care plans, visits, carers and your team.
step_text: Add the people you support. See Add a new service user. The record shows what is still missing before care starts.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS
summary: Work through Getting started, then people, care plans, visits, carers and your team.

step_text: Build their care plans and set their visits. See Build a care plan and Plan repeating visits.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS

step_text: Add your carers and invite them to the app. See Invite a carer to the app. Each carer needs an email address.

step_text: Put carers on the visits. Choose who usually goes to each call on the Plan, then check the Rota and Today > Needs cover for anything without a carer.

step_text: Check carers can see their visits. Before the first visits, the Visits list shows On phone for each carer whose phone has the visit.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS
summary: Work through Getting started, then people, care plans, visits, carers and your team.
step_text: Have to hand: your agency's address and phone number, who pays you and your rates, the people you support, and your carers' email addresses.

title: Your first week with HomecareOS
summary: Work through Getting started, then people, care plans, visits, carers and your team.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: Open Settings, then Team & access. The views are Team, Security and Audit log. Audit log shows only for roles allowed to see it.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: Check the team. Each person is listed with their email, role, job title, status and last sign-in, with a count for each role.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: Invite someone. Choose Invite someone. It opens the current team page: choose Invite Team Member. Enter their email, name, role and job title. They get an email to set up their login.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_title: Change a role or remove access
step_text: Change a role or remove access. Choose Change role beside the person. It opens the current team page, where you can change their role, deactivate them or reactivate them. Resend Invite sends an invite again.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: Set two-step sign-in. On Security, Two-step sign-in for owners shows whether owners must use it. Your account shows whether your own two-step sign-in is set up, with a link to set it up.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: Search the audit log. On Audit log, search by name, what changed, the reason or a record id, then choose Search. Each change shows when, what, the action, the record and the reason.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: Owner / Director: full access to everything, including billing. Registered Manager: full operational access, compliance sign-off and user management. Care Manager: carers, service users, rota and care plans.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: Coordinator: daily scheduling, visits, cover and messaging. Senior Carer: limited office access plus the carer app. Finance / Accounts: invoices, payroll and rates, no clinical data.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: HR Administrator: staff records, recruitment, compliance and training, no client data. Office Administrator: basic access, data entry and messaging. Read Only: can view but not edit anything.

title: Team and access: roles, sign-in security and the audit log
summary: See your office team and their roles, invite or change access, set two-step sign-in and search the audit log.
step_text: If someone invited you to another branch, Team & access lists it under Invitations to you. Accept or decline it on the current team page.

title: Invite a family member to the portal

title: Invite a family member to the portal

title: Invite a family member to the portal

title: Invite a family member to the portal

step_text: Set what they can see. Each invite has its own permissions. Change them at any time.

title: Invite a family member to the portal

step_text: Suspend or restore access. Use the buttons on their invite. Every change is kept on the record.

title: Invite a family member to the portal

title: Invite a family member to the portal
summary: Send a portal invite from the person's record, and suspend or restore access later.
